name: Ricardo Vargas Mendoza
bio:
Ricardo's career began in general administration, but a lifelong passion for motorsport led him to seek opportunities within the industry. He started by volunteering at local racing events, gradually building connections and understanding the unique human resource needs of racing teams. He believes in fostering a positive and supportive work environment, recognizing that the pressure cooker atmosphere of motorsport requires individuals to thrive both professionally and personally.

Ricardo emphasizes ethical conduct and fair treatment, striving to create a level playing field for all team members. His methodical approach ensures compliance with labor laws and industry regulations, while his dedication to employee well-being contributes to a cohesive and motivated workforce. He is known for his conflict resolution skills, often mediating disagreements and finding solutions that benefit both the individual and the team.

What sets Ricardo apart is his deep understanding of motorsport culture combined with his HR expertise. He knows what it takes to attract and retain top talent in a demanding industry, making him a valuable asset to any racing organization.

physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium build with a warm, approachable demeanor.
